title: Sales Playbook — Overview
body: Acme's sales motion is land-and-expand: an initial single-department pilot (typically 90-150 seats), a 90-day success check-in, then an expansion conversation timed to renewal. Discovery calls focus on the buyer's current tooling and time-to-answer pain points. Security and procurement reviews are handled jointly by Sales and Legal — see the security-questionnaire pattern used for the Globex account as a reference example.
